bubu.name: Bubu
bubu.seedText: Hi! I'm Bubu. I'm round, I'm happy, and my first bomb is always the biggest one. Hee hee hee, I won! Did you see that? Too easy! Oh no, oh no, my cheeks! That was so not fair!

gugu.name: Gugu
gugu.seedText: Name's Gugu. Heavy feet, thick skin, and two lives. Come and try. Ho ho ho! Who's the boss now? That's right, me. Hmpf. Again? I had a second life for this one.

zuzu.name: Zuzu
zuzu.seedText: Zuzu here! Fastest legs in the arena. Blink and you missed me. Yee-haw! You didn't even see me coming! Ow! Okay, okay, I was going too fast. Again!

striker.name: Striker
striker.seedText: Striker. Every bomb is a ball, and I never miss a penalty. GOOOAL! Champions! Put that on the scoreboard! Offside?! That was never a foul. Rematch!

fifi.name: Fifi
fifi.seedText: Fifi, darling. Graceful, charming, and I pick up everything that sparkles. Whee-hoo! With grace, of course. My bow! Do you know how long that took me?

veta.name: Auntie Veta
veta.seedText: I'm Auntie Veta. Handbag, headscarf, and absolutely zero patience. Shame on all of you! That's what manners get you! Vai… oh dear, oh dear. What is this world coming to?

chef.name: Chef
chef.seedText: I'm the Chef. I cook with fire. Literally. Dinner is served. Bon appétit! Chef's kiss! Order up! My soufflé! You ruined my soufflé!

maestru.name: Master Fitil
maestru.seedText: I am Master Fitil. I know every fuse by heart. Every tick. Every spark. Mwa-ha-ha! All according to plan, my dear apprentices. Impossible… I counted the seconds. I counted them twice!

robo.name: Robo-Mici
robo.seedText: Beep. Boop. I am Robo-Mici. Illness protocols: disabled. Boom protocols: online. Beep-boop! Victory! Mission complete! Warning. Warning. Power low. Ouch, in robot.

ghost.name: Ghost
ghost.seedText: Crates? What crates? I'm just passing through. Boo-hoo-hoo! You never saw me, did you? Wait, I'm already… oh, never mind.

magician.name: Magician
magician.seedText: Ladies and gentlemen! Now you see the bomb… now it's a pigeon! Ta-da! Thank you, thank you, you've been a wonderful audience. Where did my hat go?! It was right here!

nova.name: Nova
nova.seedText: Nova! Why aim down a line when you can hit the whole block? Supernova, baby! Light them all up! Too close… I overcooked it.

shade.name: Shade
shade.seedText: Shade. Now you see me… now it's just smoke. Smoke clears. I'm still here. Sloppy. I was careless. It won't happen twice.

portia.name: Portia
portia.seedText: I am Portia. Why walk around when you can step through? Bravissima! Take a bow, everyone, take a bow! Oh, the tragedy! The drama! The humiliation!

slick.name: Slick
slick.seedText: Name's Slick. Fast hands, faster feet, and a whole lot of ice. Smooth. Like butter, like ice, like me. Whoa, whoa, I slipped. Totally on purpose.

crainic.name: Crainic
crainic.elevenlabsVoice: Hal - Your Animated Social Media Buddy
crainic.seedText: Welcome to Fitil Arena! Light the fuse, and may the best bomber win. Three, two, one... go! What a blast! We have a champion! And that's the round, folks. Better luck next time!
